objective: Record every pinned file of testsuite-karaf 4.2.19.Final as not ported, with its reason, CLR counterpart and evidence (an Apache Karaf feature descriptor); see docs/record-only-modules.md.

ownerDecisions: No project: the module is recorded, not ported (an Apache Karaf feature descriptor). Owner decision 2026-11-16 (JVM-only units are recorded with their CLR counterpart instead of placeholder files) and 2026-11-23 (units that need a Java library without a BCL counterpart are recorded, not ported).

statusMeaning.deprecated-not-ported: @Deprecated Java unit (or a unit that serves one) recorded with its deprecation facts; no [Obsolete] facade.
statusMeaning.jvm-only-replaced: JVM-only unit replaced by its recorded CLR counterpart, or JVM build/runtime material with no CLR counterpart.
statusMeaning.library-not-ported: Needs a Java library or JDK-specific API with no BCL counterpart (owner decision 2026-11-23); recorded, not ported.
statusMeaning.clr-adapted: Ported with the original names, structure and comments; every CLR difference is stated in a // CLR: comment and in this entry.
statusMeaning.verified: Every declared original test is mapped to a C# test with the same name (case may differ) and passes.

notPorted.reason: Apache Karaf feature descriptor of the OSGi build; .NET has no OSGi container.

replacement.clr: None: assemblies are the deployment unit.

comments.reason: Original comments of a unit that is not ported: an Apache Karaf feature descriptor.
